slides.headline: JARED KUSHNER PROFITS FROM THE WAR HE IS NEGOTIATING

caption:
Jared Kushner, the biggest shareholder in an investment firm whose money flows into Israeli military suppliers, is also helping negotiate the Gaza deal. 🚨

Everyone assumed the Gaza negotiator had zero financial skin in the game. Kushner is simultaneously the largest shareholder in an Israeli investment firm that backs companies supplying equipment to the Israeli military, and helping shape Gaza's future at the negotiating table. He is not some minor investor. He is the biggest one. A ceasefire could literally cost him money.

Kushner made no public disclosure of his financial stake before beginning the Gaza talks. The ceasefire he helped negotiate covers every single person living in Gaza, over two million of them.
